subject: Edge Health — MAP: performance acceptance plan and close timeline
messages:
From: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.com>
To: Marta Ruiz <marta@edgehealth.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>, Sergio Alvarez <sergio@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 15 Mar 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Edge Health — MAP: performance acceptance plan and close timeline

Marta — attaching the MAP draft and a short benchmarking plan for acceptance (attachment: edgehealth_map_v1.pdf). Key ask: can we lock a 48-hour test window the week of Mar 22 so our infra team can run the hosted/dedicated/private apples-to-apples tests?

High level (for acceptance criteria):
- Metrics: median latency (50th), p95 latency, tokens/sec throughput, TTFT (time-to-first-token), and sustained concurrency at target QPS.
- Target baselines: p95 <= 220ms (hosted); p95 <= 120ms (dedicated); private to match dedicated within 10% when isolated. TTFT defined as time from request accept to first token bytes on the wire.
- Isolation tests: pin a dedicated node pool and run noisy-tenant simulation vs. private air-gapped VM to validate predictability.
- Autoscale behavior: ramp from 10 to 500 concurrent connections over 30 minutes and measure scale latency and cold-start impact.

Proposed timeline:
- You confirm dataset + success pass/fail criteria by EOD Fri Mar 19.
- We run bench Mar 22–23 (2 x 24h windows) and return results Mar 24.
- If acceptance met, commercial close / PO submitted Mar 26 and onboarding starts Apr 5.

Please confirm if those dates work and whether procurement needs additional docs for Private deployment (SOC2 certs, network diagram, etc.).

Thanks,
Aditya Rao
Account Executive — Redwood Inference
(attachment: edgehealth_map_v1.pdf)

From: Marta Ruiz <marta@edgehealth.com>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.com>
Cc: Edge Health Procurement <procurement@edgehealth.com>
Date: Mon, 15 Mar 2027 12:08:00 -04:00
Subject: Re: Edge Health — MAP: performance acceptance plan and close timeline

Aditya — thanks for the plan and the clarity. A couple quick clarifying questions before I confirm dates with procurement: 

1) TTFT: can you confirm the exact network path/measurement? We need this measured from our EU region gateway (we will proxy traffic from an EU endpoint).
2) For the "noisy tenant" test on Dedicated: will you simulate realistic multi-tenant traffic or do you expect us to provide load generators?
3) Private deployment: we need a short checklist of what infra you'll require so our security team can pre-approve (firewall rules, allowed outbound endpoints, KMS integration).

We are cautiously optimistic about the targets you listed, but p95 <= 120ms on Dedicated looks aggressive given our datasets. If you have a prior run with similar model sizes and sequence lengths, please share numbers.

I can confirm dates by Thu Mar 18 if you can provide those clarifications and a sample benchmark summary.

Best,
Marta Ruiz
Director of Product — Edge Health
Marta.Ruiz@edgehealth.com

On Mon, Mar 15, 2027 at 09:12 AM Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.com> wrote:
> [original message attached]

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>
To: Marta Ruiz <marta@edgehealth.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.com>
Cc: Sergio Alvarez <sergio@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 18 Mar 2027 10:32:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Edge Health — MAP: performance acceptance plan and close timeline

Marta — quick reply with a short smoke-run summary so you can see prior behavior. We ran a 3-hour comparison across the same model family (65B dense variant, 1024 token sequences) last week. Full CSV attached (benchmark-summary-20270318.csv) and a short highlight below: 

Smoke-run highlights (3h, steady-state):
- Hosted (multi-tenant, region us-west-2 proxy): median latency 82ms, p95 210ms, throughput 1,400 tokens/sec, TTFT 62ms.
- Dedicated (pinned GPU pool, same HW family): median 42ms, p95 110ms, throughput 3,600 tokens/sec, TTFT 28ms.
- Private (customer VPC + our private control plane, isolated HW): median 46ms, p95 125ms, throughput 3,200 tokens/sec, TTFT 35ms.

Notes:
- The dedicated pool was isolated from other Redwood jobs for the run; noisy-tenant simulation (50% extra background load) increased p95 to ~170ms on hosted but had negligible impact on dedicated/private.
- Autoscale behavior: cold-start penalty (first scaled node) ~18–32s to reach full capacity; subsequent warm scalebacks <8s. We can configure pre-warming for production windows.

Drive link to raw results and the runner config: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2bEdgeHealthMAP

We used a synthetic dataset matching your expected token distribution (70% short prompts, 30% long context). If you'd prefer you can run the same generator from your side to validate network effects from EU ingress.

Aditya — recommend we add a 1-hour EU-proxyed smoke test during the Mar 22 window to validate TTFT from Marta's gateway. Marta — if that works, we can proceed with the 48-hour window and I will oversee the test runs.

Rishi Malhotra
Head of Sales — Redwood Inference
(attachment: benchmark-summary-20270318.csv)

From: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.com>
To: Marta Ruiz <marta@edgehealth.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>, Sergio Alvarez <sergio@redwood.com>, Edge Health Procurement <procurement@edgehealth.com>
Date: Fri, 19 Mar 2027 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Edge Health — MAP: performance acceptance plan and close timeline

Marta — great, thank you for the quick turn. Per Rishi's notes, we have a validated baseline and are ready to execute the MAP. Confirmed updates: 

- Mar 22: 1-hour EU-proxy smoke test (validate TTFT from your gateway).
- Mar 22–23: 48-hour comparative benchmark (hosted vs dedicated vs private). We will run the noisy-tenant scenario during a dedicated 4-hour window inside the 48h run.
- Deliverables: full CSV results, summary slide deck, and an acceptance checklist where each metric is pass/fail.

Procurement: Sergio, looping you for commercial/PO intake details. Can you share the shortest path for a one-off PoC order and any contract redlines we should expect?

Marta — if you reply ACK (by EOD today) we will lock resources and share the lab run schedule / test endpoints. After a successful acceptance run we will follow the MAP close steps and expect PO submission by Mar 26 to meet the Apr 5 onboarding date.

Thanks — looking forward to getting this across the line.

Aditya Rao
Account Executive — Redwood Inference
aditya@redwood.com
Mobile: +1 (415) 555-0179
